basic_details.job_title: RREC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Assistant Engineer / Executive Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Rajasthan Renewable Energy Corporation Limited (RRECL), Jaipur, a Government of Rajasthan undertaking, is engaging three retired Assistant Engineers (AENs) or Executive Engineers (XENs) (Civil) on a Pay Minus Pension basis. One post is at the Bikaner Headquarter and two are at the Jaipur Headquarter. Applicants must be below 65 years of age. Applications can be given in person at the RRECL office in Jaipur or sent by email to [email protected]. The deadline is 5:00 PM on 6 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice allows two ways to apply. Both must be used by 5:00 PM on 6 November 2026:
Give the application in person at the office of RRECL, Jaipur, or
Send the application by email to [email protected].
The notice does not set an application format or a list of documents to attach.
important_instructions: Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. Only eligible and interested candidates should apply. The notice was issued by the General Manager (GA), RRECL.

content_sections.heading: About RRECL
content_sections.text: Rajasthan Renewable Energy Corporation Limited (RRECL) is a Government of Rajasthan undertaking based in Jaipur. Its letterhead gives its address as E-166, Yudhisthir Marg, C-Scheme, Jaipur, and its telephone numbers as 2225859, 2228198 and 2221650. Its CIN is U40101RJ1995SGC009847, and its general email address is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists three retired AEN/XEN (Civil) positions at two headquarters.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same eligibility rules apply to both posts. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The age limit is "below 65 years", so a candidate who has reached 65 cannot apply. The notice does not print a date on which age is counted. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RRECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for retired AENs/XENs (Civil): 1 at the Bikaner Headquarter and 2 at the Jaipur Headquarter.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the RRECL retired AEN/XEN posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be in by 5:00 PM on 6 November 2026. Applications received after this deadline will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for RRECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Retired Assistant Engineers (AENs) or Executive Engineers (XENs) (Civil) who are below 65 years of age can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the RRECL retired AEN/XEN posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be below 65 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the RRECL retired AEN/XEN (Civil) posts?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a Pay Minus Pension basis, subject to the applicable rules and the approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. How is the pay of the retired engineers fixed?
faq.answer: The retired AENs/XENs (Civil) will be engaged on a Pay Minus Pension basis, subject to the applicable rules and the approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for RRECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Give your application in person at the office of RRECL, Jaipur, or email it to [email protected], by 5:00 PM on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected retired engineers be posted?
faq.answer: One retired AEN/XEN (Civil) will be deployed at the Bikaner Headquarter and two retired AENs/XENs (Civil) at the Jaipur Headquarter.
